referendums.name: CONSTITUTIONAL AMENDMENT 1: Increasing funding to school districts
referendums.ballotLanguage: Shall the Minnesota Constitution be amended to increase the funding going to all school districts from the permanent school fund, which is a fund that supports school districts without raising individual income or property taxes, effective July 1, 2027?

referendums.name: TOWNSHIP QUESTION 1 (Deer River Twp): Change To Optional Plan B Appointment of Clerk and Treasurer
referendums.ballotLanguage: Shall option B, providing for the appointment of the clerk and treasurer by the town board, be adopted for the government of the town?

referendums.name: CITY QUESTION 1 (Marble): Change To Optional Plan A Appointment of Clerk and Treasurer
referendums.ballotLanguage: Shall Optional Plan A, modifying the standard plan of city government by providing for the appointment by the council of the clerk and treasurer be adopted for the government of the city?
